title: Automating for Failure: Disaster Recovery Testing with Terraform & Gremlin
by: Samson Olufuwa and Olubusayo Amowe (Fuerza), published by HashiCorp
summary: A 27-minute introductory talk on disaster recovery: the common strategies (backup and restore, pilot light, warm standby, multi-region), RTO and RPO, and how keeping infrastructure in Terraform modules and AMIs lets you rebuild it quickly, with a demo on AWS and regular drills to test the plan. The slides cover Terraform far more than Gremlin, and say plainly that Terraform does not back up your data; published on HashiCorp’s site, so it favours Terraform.
